# On and off by default — the `node` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#node).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — a project adds it.
- **Rules:** 40 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 10 off in an opt-in preset, 30 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `node/recommended` | no — opt in | 10 | 10 error | eslint-plugin-n 18.5.0 recommended-module: the rules that need no package.json, hashbang on package.json's bin, and the import rules on the project graph, reimplemented |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.
